name: Supervisor
notes: Leads a team of agents; first-line supervisory tier.

name: Director
notes: Senior leadership over a division/program (e.g. Program Manager — NEMT).

name: Manager
notes: Manages supervisors/agents and a functional area or program.

name: Agent
notes: Front-line rep / individual contributor (e.g. NEMT coordinator, customer care agent).

name: Staff
notes: Generic staff / no specific tier assigned — default fallback.
